rules.stageWeights: 25% each; normalize over observed stages only
rules.calibration: observed stage mean equals existing course score; stages are synthesized from the anchor, not real historical evidence
rules.itemScoring: stage score equals mean of 3 latest item scores; first and retry records retained
rules.missing: not_observed is null, never zero; no inferred score for absent assessments
rules.dailyActivity: sum of event_count exactly equals original learning_activity count per student/course/term/week
rules.duration: explicit fictional duration; not a real inference from clicks
rules.graphEdges: explicit fictional teaching sequence and question membership, not statistical correlation
rules.smallGroups: preview hides nonempty aggregates with fewer than 3 students
rules.integration: extension files and offline aggregate preview; production APIs and AI tools not changed
